question: Why is it that octopuses have three hearts and blue blood?
why: Bản dài của Short "Did you know octopuses have three hearts and blue blood?": cùng điều thú vị đó, giải thích kỹ hơn. Surprising, easy to verify on Wikipedia (Octopus). Easy to show with two pictures: an octopus with three glowing hearts, and a drop of blue blood. Kids love repeating it, and it is safe and friendly.
